correctness.rationale: For d>=3 the intrinsic spherical excess in the three-point great 2-sphere has mean π/2 exactly. Writing the three independent-point Gram overlaps as x,y,z gives L=-(x+y+z), Q=xy+xz+yz, C=-(Σ_sym x²y)/2-(x³+y³+z³)/6. Expansion of the three tangent-angle arccosines has degree-4 remainder controlled on max|overlap|<=1/8; exponential concentration controls its complement. Isotropy gives E x²=1/d, E x⁴=3/[d(d+2)], E xyz=E x²y²=d^-2; cross terms reconstruct Var=3/d+3/d²+3/[d(d+2)]+O(d^-5/2), hence 3/d+6/d², and centered third moment 12/d²+O(d^-5/2). Gaussian-normalized coordinates yield the stated CLT. The finite checker source was inspected, not used to replace asymptotic proof.
residual_risks: Bounded finite checks are only corroboration; universal quantifiers follow from the cited analytic proof.
